_notes: Close-friends story templates. Register: group chat, not audience — short, flat, unpolished captions. film = what she captures from her real day; caption = starting point she retypes in her own words; emoji + sticker_text drive the visual mockup on her page. If a post feels like it is performing, it belongs on the main story, not close friends.

reels.concept: Silent day-in-the-life: 8-10 two-second clips of an ordinary day, trending calm audio. Use First Draft to auto-stitch the rough cut.

reels.hook: things in my apartment that just make sense
reels.concept: 5 quick pans to small home details with text labels. Low effort, high save-rate format.
Talking-head clips between stops, stitched with First Draft. Personality carries it, not the errands.
The aspirational routine format with honest captions ('skincare = whatever's closest'). Test as a Trial Reel first.
Photo-dump reel of the month's best 15 photos on a nostalgic audio. Schedule as a Trial Reel for month-end.

reels.hook: what I ordered vs what arrived
reels.concept: Any purchase with an expectation/reality beat. Works even when the reality is fine.

reels.hook: POV: your friend who's always doing something
reels.concept: Fast montage of the week's activities, beat-synced in Edits with Loudness Match for clean audio.
Sped-up morning tidy + matcha + hair, one continuous vibe, no talking.

reels.hook: day in the life: girl who lifts
reels.concept: Alarm → gym → meal → work → night. Timestamps on screen. Trial Reel to reach non-followers in fitness.

reels.hook: what I eat in a day (realistic version)
reels.concept: Every meal, honest portions, no lecture. Evergreen format in fitness niche.
Cinematic slow clips of normal moments — coffee pour, book, walk — luxe audio.
Take yourself somewhere nice, film 6 clips, voiceover why solo dates matter.

reels.hook: rating everything I bought at Target
reels.concept: Haul with fast honest ratings out of 10. Comment bait: people defend their favorites.
Front-camera storytelling while doing a mundane task. First Draft trims the pauses.
3 outfit transitions cut on a heavy beat drop. Flash photo aesthetic.
The contrast format — tattoos then baking, boots then plants. Contrast hooks travel; test as Trial Reel.
Full glam voiceover GRWM telling a story unrelated to the makeup. The story retains, the glam converts follows.
Golden-hour montage: fields, tailgates, water, bonfire. Country audio, wide shots.

reels.hook: habits that changed my year (proof included)
reels.concept: Each habit shown being done, not talked about. Save-magnet format.

features_to_try.name: 60-second stories
features_to_try.why: Stories no longer split at 15s — talking clips and mini-vlogs flow better. Use for one longer 'talking to the gc' story per day max.

features_to_try.name: Story comments
features_to_try.why: Public comments on stories are new — turn them on for fit checks and talking stories; visible conversation makes close friends feel like a group chat.

features_to_try.name: Reveal sticker
features_to_try.why: Hides part of a story until viewers DM — fun curiosity mechanic for coffee orders and locations. Use sparingly (1-2/week) so it stays playful.

features_to_try.name: Frames sticker
features_to_try.why: Polaroid shake-to-develop effect — perfect for flowers, nails, and film-photo energy.

features_to_try.name: Cutouts
features_to_try.why: Cut any object from a photo into a sticker — great for meme-y 'look at this thing I found' stories.

features_to_try.name: Add Yours Music
features_to_try.why: Song-trade chains recruit replies from people who never answer question boxes.

features_to_try.name: Trial Reels (+ scheduling)
features_to_try.why: Test a reel with non-followers only before committing it to your grid. Schedule one trial per week; promote winners.

features_to_try.name: First Draft
features_to_try.why: Auto-trims pauses across clips into an editable rough cut — cuts talking-reel edit time massively.

features_to_try.name: Edits app — Loudness Match
features_to_try.why: Evens out audio levels between clips so voiceovers sound clean without editing skill.
